import random, math, statistics
def coupon_collector_trial(n, rng=random):
    seen=[False]*n
    collected=0
    draws=0
    while collected<n:
        c=rng.randrange(n)
        draws+=1
        if not seen[c]:
            seen[c]=True
            collected+=1
    return draws

def simulate(n, trials=10000, seed=0):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    samples=[coupon_collector_trial(n,rng) for _ in range(trials)]
    mean=sum(samples)/trials
    var=sum((x-mean)**2 for x in samples)/(trials-1)
    return mean, math.sqrt(var), samples
